episodes.final_message: Midterm week and heavy coursework can feel really isolating, and it makes total sense that connection feels low right now. If you have a few minutes tonight, consider sending a quick text to a close friend or taking a tiny coffee break to reset.
Since I don't have your recent sleep or stress check-ins from the last few days, I wanted to check in as you navigate deadlines this week. How are your energy and stress levels holding up today?

Navigating 3 deadlines today amidst 'a blizzard of emotions' is so heavy, and it makes complete sense that you're feeling overwhelmed. To make things feel a bit lighter, try picking just one small piece of your coursework and spending 25 focused minutes on it, followed by a gentle break.
